fields.Name: T351 - Dependency Graph Relationship Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises NavigateToEntity cross-entity re-selection (clears the schema filter and re-derives relationships for the clicked neighbor) — interactive graph traversal distinct from the initial entity-select path.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → Dependency Graph (left nav), select an entity so its detail panel loads. Then, in the 'Referenced By' or 'Depends On' list, click one of the related entities and confirm the detail panel switches to that newly-clicked entity — its name becomes the detail title and its own Referenced By / Depends On relationships load. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: After selecting an entity, related entities in Referenced By/Depends On are clickable
Clicking a related entity switches the detail panel to that entity (title and relationship lists update)
The newly selected entity becomes the active/highlighted selection
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
